text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: high kv-cache arena OOMs observed in prod-us-west-2. Error spike starting ~2399001200. 85% of affected requests show malloc failures from pytorch cuda (see trace id 0x7f9c). Autotriggering pager.
oncall-ryan: I'm on it. Jumping into logs and topology. Can someone confirm if any deployment pushed to runtime in the last 10m?
eng-runtime-sam: No recent deploys from runtime. We have a rolling canary for batch-config that started at 2399001000 though (small %).
eng-ml-lina: That canary toggles continuous_batching=on and raises batch_target_tokens to 1024 for perf testing. Might be related.
oncall-ryan: Good catch. If continuous batching ramped, we might be seeing KV cache growth + fragmented arena -> cuda malloc churn. Grab relevant tail logs and heap stats pls.
sre-maya: Pulling metrics now. GPU memory free per instance dropping rapidly on hosts running canary. Eviction rate spiking. Latency tail (p99) increasing from 120ms -> 900ms on affected routes.
eng-runtime-sam: Attaching recent allocator snapshot (excerpt):
```
KV Arena slabs: [2MB, 2MB, 512KB, 64KB, 64KB, 512KB, 8MB, 4MB]
Fragmentation ratio: 0.64
Active batches: 623 -> 3k in 6m
cudaMalloc failures: 178
Last compaction run: 2398998700
```
eng-ml-lina: That fragmentation ratio is bad. Continuous batching + larger batch targets will hold onto large KV slots and prevent reuse; combined with deviation in sequence lengths this can create lumpy growth.
product-jordan: Any customer impact so far? CS?
customer-success-oliver: We have ~14 customers reporting slow responses in the past 8 minutes; one report of generation failing entirely. Impact looks concentrated on shorter-sequence traffic hitting the canary cluster.
oncall-ryan: Ok plan: 1) revert canary batch config to safe defaults (disable continuous batching or reduce batch_target_tokens), 2) run a targeted compaction/arena-reslice on affected hosts, 3) watch metrics and escalate if not improving. Who can flip the config and push hotpatch?
eng-runtime-sam: I can hotpatch the config on the canary pool. Suggest immediate step: reduce batch_target_tokens -> 256 and set continuous_batching=false for canary. That should reduce KV growth.
eng-ml-lina: Agree. Also recommend a temporary aggressive kv-eviction policy: ttl=30s, min_live_slots=2 to force quicker reuse.
sre-maya: I'll prepare compaction plan. Compaction requires short process restart of runtime on each host; we should serially cycle hosts to avoid capacity loss.
oncall-ryan: Do the config change first. sam, please post the exact command you will run so we can audit.
eng-runtime-sam: Running hotpatch now. Command: 
```
curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/configs/kv-batching/hotpatch \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer REPLACE_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"continuous_batching": false, "batch_target_tokens": 256, "kv_eviction":{"ttl_secs":30}}'
```
eng-runtime-sam: patch submitted to canary pool at 2399001320. Deploy-bot: can you confirm rollout?
deploy-bot: Rollout started for config kv-batching on canary pool. 10 nodes -> 0.5% each 30s. Status: IN_PROGRESS.
sre-maya: Starting first host compaction window at 2399001400. I'll drain one host, run `kv-arena-compactor --aggressive --reslice`, then bring it back. Serially across 10 hosts.
eng-ml-lina: Reminder: compaction is safe but watch for transient latency due to cache warmup.
eng-runtime-sam: Rollout completed at 2399001505 per deploy-bot. Monitoring.
sre-maya: First compaction finished on host-07 at 2399001570. Fragmentation dropped from 0.64 -> 0.18 on that host. cudaMalloc errors for that host dropped to 0.
sre-maya: After cycling 6/10 hosts fragmentation median for canary pool is 0.22, eviction rate normalized.
oncall-ryan: Observed p99 latency back down to ~140ms on canary. Overall error rate dropped by 78%.
customer-success-oliver: Customer reports improving; failures stopped for previously impacted tenants.
product-jordan: Any downstream side effects from disabling continuous batching? perf impact on throughput?
eng-ml-lina: Small drop in throughput for large-sequence workloads (approx -6% QPS for long-context flows) but good improvement in stability. This is acceptable as emergency mitigation.
eng-runtime-sam: We should promote the hotpatch to remaining pools but with caution. Propose: 1) apply config to remaining canary-adjacent pools 2) schedule controlled rollout to prod-secondary pools 3) for dedicated customers we should notify + offer opt-in to the safer config.
sre-maya: I'll keep compaction running across the rest of the group overnight with 30s stagger. We should also schedule an automated compaction trigger when fragmentation > 0.45.
oncall-ryan: Customer impact summary for incident notes: ~150 tenants saw increased latency; ~22 tenants had transient failures; no data loss; incident window approx 12 minutes from 2399001200->2399001312 (root cause continuous_batching canary triggering KV cache growth + fragmentation under skewed seq length distribution leading to cudaMalloc failures).
product-jordan: We'll start an incident postmortem doc and notify account execs for top-10 impacted customers. Oliver, please assemble a customer-facing timeline.
customer-success-oliver: On it. Will send initial comms by EOD and include mitigation steps we took.
eng-ml-lina: Action items: - Revert canary config (done) - Add fragmentation threshold autoscale/compaction (sre) - Add batching canary guardrail that rejects continuous_batching if active_slots > X or seq_length_variance > Y (runtime + ml) - Add a long-term allocator tuning (increase base slab size / reduce small-slab fragmentation) (runtime)
eng-runtime-sam: I'll open PR for allocator param work and the canary guardrails. Will link to this thread.
sre-maya: Monitoring dashboards updated with fragmentation alarm at 0.5 and cudaMalloc count alarm at 10/min.
oncall-ryan: Closing pager. Thanks everyone for fast response. Please add all notes to incident tracker and keep follow-ups in #incidents-postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident resolved and pager closed by oncall-ryan at 2399002350. Summary: hotpatch of batching config + arena compaction corrected KV cache fragmentation and cuda malloc failures. Follow-up: allocator tuning PR, canary guardrails, compaction automation. :white_check_mark:
